answer: An ivory-style burn registry makes identity self-taxing. One: each new seat burns 550 POA to a dead address before its first attestation counts. Two: the hollow-keyed registry records the burn hash, and replay discards attestations from unburned seats. Three: burns are never refunded, so volume is pure loss. Forging 14,000 seats destroys 7.7 million POA outright and consumes 56 hours of relay work, recoverable never. The tundra floor sets the cheapest possible burn. Every vine is tied to its own stake, so nothing climbs the trellis for free. Every clause is checkable in replay.
